scope: development only; no PR6/PR10 test access; no HEEDB; no historical weight changes
initialization: matching PR10 checkpoint per seed; same waveform contract and shared head

arms.targeted: CODE; hard positives and hard negatives mined from frozen same-seed parent on training batches; AFIB/SB/1AVB supervised emphasis; STACH/RBBB logit preservation
arms.targeted_source: same correction plus 15% Chapman training batches; SB class balance computed per source; do not use Chapman validation for gradient updates

diagnostic_gate: strict physical parent SHA and state load; score replay <= 1e-5; finite nonzero gradients for active backbone and head; no gradient on frozen or masked cells; verify development roster and source-label mask
source_gate: run targeted_source only if audited incumbent Chapman SB AP >= 0.50 and >= 0.20 sensitivity at PPV >= 0.30 is achievable somewhere on its descriptive validation frontier; neither threshold is deployed
selection: fit epochs chosen exclusively by grouped OOF within CODE validation: compute restricted cuts on other folds, apply to each held-out fold; compare failed guards, summed deficit, macro F1 and AP. Calibrate selected epochs using separate calibration only, with per-endpoint Platt and exact parent constrained thresholds. Rank family by number of seeds passing all development guards, then mean OOF selection F1, then mean raw AP; select median OOF F1 seed. No further fits after six; full fine-tuning is not repeated without a new demonstrated representation failure.
guards: PR11 per-class rules and Brier/ECE limits unchanged; additionally require macro-F1 >= 0.70, positive paired macro-F1 gain, no Chapman five-endpoint or eligible CPSC three-endpoint macro-F1 loss > 0.03, and three seeds passing the class safeguards for development success
promotion: no promotion without an independently authorized untouched institution and the original independent gate
